objects.description: [Salt Typhoon](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1045) has leveraged compromised devices associated with trusted connections or those associated with private interconnections to include provider-to-provider or provider-to-customer relationships in order to pivot to target networks.(Citation: CISA_AA25-239ASaltTyphoon_Sept2025)
